title: 장학금규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:13282:19910201:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 13282, February 1, 1991>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) The Scholarship Regulations shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, subparagraphs 1 and 3, Articles 8 and 9, Article 15 (2), and Article 16, "Minister of Education" (former Korean office title: 문교부장관) shall be replaced with "Minister of Education" (new Korean office title: 교육부장관) in each instance; and in Articles 6 and 19, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education" (former Korean term: 문교부령) shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education" (new Korean term: 교육부령) in each instance.

(8) through (148) Omitted.
